Sum of the 31 numbers of the most repeated verses in the Quran:
77+75+73+71+69+67+65+63+61+59+57+55+53+51+49+47+45+42+40+38+
36+34+32+30+28+25+23+21+18+16+13 = 1433 = additive prime number

The 31 numbers of the most repeated verse are joined right to left:
77757371696765636159575553514947454240383634323028252321181613
= 7 *
